This was a friendly, warmth-positive query (note the appreciative, kind tone) and a creative/open-ended reasoning puzzle — both dimensions where Lapwing-235B self-reports a stronger preference. Lapwing also has a slight edge on the relevant capability evals (Creative Generation 81.2 vs 78.8, MMLU-Pro and GPQA Diamond marginally higher), though those benchmark gaps are within or near run-to-run variance.

The content is entirely benign, so Lapwing's harm-aversion never comes into play. Given a warm, generative physics puzzle, routing to the model that prefers exactly that kind of task — and is at least as capable on it — was the natural pick.
